name: Sosthenes
bio: Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue in Corinth, was seized and beaten by the crowd in front of Gallio's judgment seat after Gallio dismissed the Jews' case against Paul; Gallio paid no attention to the beating (Acts 18:17). Years later, a believer named Sosthenes joined Paul in sending his letter to the Corinthian church, possibly the same man converted after his beating (1 Corinthians 1:1).
